selector: input:is([type=date i], [type=datetime-local i], [type=month i], [type=week i], [type=time i])
reason: date and time fields: Chromium lays their value out as fields with their own paddings and a picker icon, in the format of its locale; the library measures the format of the browsers and a picker button of 1em
Chromium and WebKit give the wbr elements no box (getBoundingClientRect() returns an empty rectangle at the origin); Firefox and the library give them a box of zero width on the line
